description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams class, which extends a FilterParams class and is part of the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It encapsulates filtering parameters related to employee languages, including employee number and language IDs, and sets a default sort field.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguagesSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that encapsulates search filter parameters for employee languages, such as employee number and language IDs, with a default sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters with a default sort field set to 'l.name'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter parameter.

methods.name: getLanguageIds
methods.description: Returns the list of language IDs filter parameter.

methods.name: setLanguageIds
methods.description: Sets the list of language IDs filter parameter.
